visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a lavender sweater, faces the camera in a medium close-up shot. Her expression is curious as she speaks, with a neutral indoor background featuring curtains and a window. (2) The scene shifts to a high-angle shot in a brightly lit living room. The woman lies horizontally on a light beige sofa. A second woman, wearing a black top and a pink mask, enters the frame from the left, carrying a makeup kit. They interact briefly as the makeup artist prepares. (3) A series of fast-cut close-ups follows, showing the makeup artist's hands using various tools: a sponge for foundation, an eyebrow pencil, an eyeliner brush, and a lip brush on the lying woman's face. The lying woman keeps her eyes mostly closed. (4) The woman is now covered with a white blanket on the sofa. The makeup artist sits beside her, pointing toward the camera and her own face while talking. A cat tower and miscellaneous home items are visible in the background. (5) The woman appears in a series of close-up glamour shots, showcasing her finished makeup. She wears a white top, poses with her hands near her face, and smiles subtly towards the lens in a high-contrast, brightly lit setting.
